snippet.title: Trenches VR - Horror WW1 Game Release Date Announcement Trailer (PSVR2, Meta Quest & SteamVR)
snippet.description:
Trenches VR is a psychological horror game where your microphone becomes part of the terror - enemies can hear your real-life breathing, whispers, or cries for help. Stay quiet, stay hidden… or they’ll come for you. 

Coming on 22, OCTOBER 2025 to Playstation VR2, Meta Quest 2/3 and SteamVR! 

Wishlist on STEAM VR ►► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2687660/Trenches_VR/

Wishlist on META QUEST ►► https://www.meta.com/experiences/trenches-vr/9687339424726615/

Wishlist on PSVR2 ►► https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10006527 (Add the base version to your wishlist, and you will be notified when the VR will release!)

Join DISCORD ►► https://discord.com/invite/d8WUuuRCJK

Trenches VR is First-Person World War I Survival Horror VR game where you have to escape the claustrophobic environment and experience the war from the eyes of a soldier caught behind enemy lines.  In this surreal nightmare, fight for your life and for your sanity as you explore the harsh war-torn environment.   You’re only motive is to return to your family.  Your only help.  An old trench whistle and your instincts to survive. 

Support me on PATREON in my development and dream and get EARLY ACCESS to all my games ► https://patreon.com/steelkrill
